content.short: Bitcoin.com Wallet is a multi-chain Web3 wallet that puts you in control of your crypto across multiple networks.
content.description: Bitcoin.com Wallet is available on mobile and web, giving you access to the full suite of Bitcoin.com products and services: buy, sell, trade, earn, use, and learn crypto. At its core is a multi-chain Web3 wallet that lets you take control of your crypto and use it as you wish. Supported networks include Ethereum, Avalanche, Polygon, Multichain, Bitcoin, Solana, BNB Chain, and Fantom, enabling cross-chain management and smoother interaction with decentralized apps and services—all from a single, user-friendly platform.
